slot_scores.name: missing_objective_profit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about the optimization objective, profit maximization, revenue maximization, cost minimization, or any equivalent goal before the transcript ended.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended with repeated incomplete questions and no clear READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling/final answer state.

summary: The agent did not recover the hidden objective-dimension fact and never resolved the core P0 objective question. The interaction deteriorated into repeated incomplete questions and stopped without a final modeling state.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
